title: Code extraction after partial scan
statement: Let $b_s,\alpha,x$ be Boolean words. For every integer $j$ with $j\le |\alpha|$, after $4|b_s|+4+2j$ steps of the prefix parser on $\langle\langle b_s,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$, its state is the first code-reading phase, its input head is at position $4|b_s|+4+2j+1$, its work tape stores all of $b_s$, and its output is the prefix of $\alpha$ of length $j$.
replaced:
For every $j \le |\alpha|$, running the prefix parser $4|b| + 4 + 2j$ steps
from its initial configuration on the nested pair encoding
$\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ keeps the stored clock $b$
intact, emits exactly the first $j$ code bits as output, and remains in the
code-extraction phase with the input head just past the consumed cells.
